_note: Global Business Preferences for the Tableau Knowledge graph. Create each item with manage-knowledge-context (action create, isGlobal true, graphId of your graph, name = title, statements = [text]). Replace {{RPT_PROJECT_PATH}} with the path of the project that holds the rpt_ data sources, written with ' > ' between levels.

items.title: Usage: Which data sources to use
items.text: Use the `rpt_samplehyperstore__` data sources in {{RPT_PROJECT_PATH}} for analysis; the `SampleHyperStore - <table>` data sources are raw tables for lineage only.

items.title: Usage: Say which data source's metric you used
items.text: Several data sources have metrics with the same name; always say which data source's metric you used.

items.title: Term: Default meaning of sales and revenue
items.text: "Sales" or "revenue" without a qualifier means `Revenue` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders`; use `Revenue` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__billing` when the question mentions fiscal periods, net revenue, returns or marketplace fees.

items.title: Term: Fiscal periods for Finance questions
items.text: For Finance questions, "this year", "last year" and "monthly" mean fiscal periods: group by `Fiscal Month`.

items.title: Term: Late delivery means after the promised date
items.text: A delivery is late when `Delivered Date` is after `Promised Delivery Date`; use `Carrier Estimated Delivery Date` only for carrier performance.

items.title: Term: No results vs nothing in stock in search
items.text: In search questions, "no results" means `No-results Rate` (no matching product) and "nothing in stock" means `Out-of-stock Results Rate`.

items.title: Method: Sales region realignment on 2025-01-01
items.text: To compare sales regions across years spanning 2025-01-01, compare by `State Code`, not by `Sales Region Id`.

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__billing
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__billing`, trend metrics by `Invoice Date` (or `Fiscal Month`); exceptions: `Credits` and `Net Refund Cost` by `Credit Memo Date` (or `Fiscal Month (credit_memos.csv)`), and in Finance's posting view, all credit memo amounts by `Fiscal Month (credit_memos.csv)`, not by the original invoice's month.

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders`, trend all metrics by `Order Date`, in calendar months.

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising`, trend all metrics by `Order Date`, in calendar months.

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__shipments
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__shipments`, trend metrics by `Shipped Date` in calendar months; exception: `Perfect Order Rate` by `Order Date`.

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds`, trend metrics by `Requested Date` in calendar months; exceptions: `Refunds` and `Cash Refunds` by `Refunded Date`, `Received Units` by `Received Date`, `Days from Order to Return Request` and `Returned Order Lines` by `Order Date` (order cohort).

items.title: Default date: rpt_samplehyperstore__web_analytics
items.text: In `rpt_samplehyperstore__web_analytics`, trend metrics by `Session Start Date` in calendar months; exceptions: `No-results Rate`, `Out-of-stock Results Rate` and `No-click Rate` by `Searched Date`, `Units Added to Cart` by `Cart Added Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Requested return rate
items.text: Requested return rate (Customer Support) = `Requested Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds` by month of `Requested Date` ÷ `Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders` by month of `Order Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Order-cohort return rate
items.text: Order-cohort return rate (Merchandising) = `Requested Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds` ÷ `Net Ordered Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising`, both by month of `Order Date`, with the same filters on both.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Received return rate
items.text: Received return rate (Logistics) = `Received Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds` by month of `Received Date` ÷ `Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__shipments` by month of `Shipped Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Return line incidence
items.text: Return line incidence (Merchandising) = `Returned Order Lines` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__returns_refunds` ÷ `Order Lines` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising`, by product and month of `Order Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Net shipping cost
items.text: Net shipping cost (Finance) = `Freight Cost` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__shipments` by month of `Shipped Date` − `Shipping Billed` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__billing` by month of `Invoice Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Orders per session
items.text: Orders per session (Sales) = `Orders` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders` for the web and app channels by `Order Date` ÷ `Sessions` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__web_analytics` by `Session Start Date`.

items.title: Cross-source metric: Unit cart abandonment
items.text: Unit cart abandonment (Merchandising) = 1 − `Units` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__merchandising` for web and app orders ÷ `Units Added to Cart` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__web_analytics`, both by week (`Order Date` and `Cart Added Date`).

items.title: Cross-source metric: Marketplace fee rate on booked sales
items.text: Marketplace fee rate on booked sales (Sales) = `Marketplace Fees` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__billing` by month of `Invoice Date` ÷ `Revenue` in `rpt_samplehyperstore__sales_orders` for the marketplace channel by month of `Order Date`.
